why: Dated, sourced, severity-graded off-field signals, recorded one at a time through football/offfield/record_signal.js. This is the same narrow door football/availability/operator.json is: everything here is typed by a person against a document they opened, and an entry missing any required field is refused at the door rather than written and trusted later.
never: No signal here may move the projected margin. The engine's off-field layer feeds information confidence and volatility ONLY, and that is deliberate: a suspension makes a team less predictable, and a model that let a headline move a spread would be reading the news instead of the football.
